description: Slow, drawn-out Reese bass over an A minor bass line (Am, F, C, G) at 174 BPM, the usual drum and bass tempo.
Hold one key and the built-in step sequencer plays an acid line with this sound.
A six bar A minor hook at 150 BPM on the Scream Lead sound: rising runs with slides, answering phrases, a leap to the peak, pitch scoops and vibrato on the long last note.
Hold a chord and the built-in arpeggiator plays it with the Siren sound.
An eight bar D minor bass line at 174 BPM: a long note, an octave pop and a short run, repeated over D, B flat and C, with a rising ending.
Deep sub bass at 174 BPM following D, C, A and G, two bars each, with a short note leading into every chord change.
